failure_modes: Failed or missing translations can strip Japanese/Chinese characters or return literal ellipsis.
Browser fallback can return untranslated source text on failure.
One original cache keys only source text; other caches record languages but neither records provider, model, work/episode identity or source hash.
CJK text was classified as Japanese regardless of country or actual source language.

original_source_probe.scope: Six representative source files; entire-title completeness and all 427 source manifests remain unverified

interpretation_limits: Duplicate dialogue is a review signal, not sufficient evidence to merge anime identities or determine which episode is correct.
Standalone ellipses can be real dialogue; arbitrary removal would corrupt subtitles. Cache failures are confirmed by meaningful source text mapping to placeholder output.
Scores, inherited IDs, release episode totals and linguistic accuracy are not independently verified by structural parsing.
The original unpublished batch is preserved and not automatically promoted to published or verified content.
A ranked candidate plan is not a translation result; 500 requested additional works remain untranslated by this update.

episode completeness and linguistic review before complete-anime claims
